message: You forgot to add a description to the idea so please add a description to it

plan.goal: Add a clear standalone description to the selected idea (Decoupling Diversity from D)

args.instruction: The idea is missing a clear standalone description. Produce a revised version of this idea that adds a concise, plain-language description summarizing what it proposes and why, while keeping all the existing content (assumption, technique, why_this_is_different, open_questions, rationale) intact.

steps.why: Adding a description is a targeted, light touch to the existing idea, not new generation — a single-pass refinement covers it.

done_criteria: the revised candidate includes a non-empty description field
the existing technique, rationale, and open_questions content is preserved
